product_overview: A single-page personal portfolio that introduces the author, showcases skills, projects and experience, and provides a contact form to message the owner. The site is responsive and animated with interactive visual effects and smooth in-page navigation.
core_goals: Introduce the author and role with an animated hero section
Allow visitors to browse categorized technical skills
Enable visitors to explore project cards and open live demos
Present professional experience in a readable timeline
Provide a contact form for visitors to send messages directly
Offer smooth, responsive navigation and engaging visual interactions

features.name: Navigation Bar
features.description: Responsive top navigation that lets visitors move between page sections and shows the current active section.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View navbar with inline section links on desktop -> Select Projects from navigation -> Observe page scroll to Projects section

Navigate to / -> View navbar on small viewport with hamburger menu visible -> Toggle mobile menu open -> Select Contact from navigation -> Observe mobile menu closes and page scrolls to Contact section
Navigate to / -> Scroll down past 50px -> Observe navbar background becomes opaque with blur -> Continue scrolling -> Observe active section highlighted in navbar

features.name: Hero Section
features.description: Landing introduction with animated name, typing role taglines, bio, CTAs and social links to start engagement.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Observe animated hero content and particle background behind it -> Observe typing animation cycling through role taglines
Navigate to / -> Select the primary CTA to view work -> Observe page scroll to Projects section
Navigate to / -> Select the secondary CTA to get in touch -> Observe page scroll to Contact section
Navigate to / -> Click a social link -> Observe external profile or mail intent open

features.name: Particle Background
features.description: Interactive canvas particle animation that runs behind page content for visual depth.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Observe interactive particle background animating behind content while browsing the page

features.name: Tech Stack Section
features.description: Categorized display of technical skills with icons and hover interactions to highlight individual items.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Scroll to Tech Stack section -> Observe Frontend category active by default and its skills displayed
Navigate to / -> Scroll to Tech Stack section -> Select the All category -> Observe skills from all categories displayed
Navigate to / -> Scroll to Tech Stack section -> Select the Backend category -> Observe only backend skills displayed
Navigate to / -> Scroll to Tech Stack section -> Hover over a skill item -> Observe icon highlight and brand-color effect

features.name: Projects Grid
features.description: Grid of project cards showing title, description, tech tags and links to live demos.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Scroll to Projects section -> Observe project cards with title, description and tech tags
Navigate to / -> Scroll to Projects section -> Select an external project link -> Observe the project demo open in a new tab
Navigate to / -> Scroll to Projects section -> Hover over a project card -> Observe lift and glow interactive effect

features.name: Experience Section
features.description: Timeline-style listing of roles and learning experiences with visible periods, descriptions and skill tags.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Scroll to Experience section -> Observe vertical gradient timeline line and glowing timeline dots
Navigate to / -> Scroll to Experience section -> Inspect a role entry -> Observe role, type, period, description and related tags rendered
Navigate to / -> Scroll to Experience section on a narrow viewport -> Observe reduced card padding and stacked layout

features.name: Contact Form
features.description: Contact area with info cards and a form that sends messages via EmailJS, including client-side validation and feedback.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Scroll to Contact section -> View contact info cards (Email, Location, Availability)
Navigate to / -> Scroll to Contact section -> Click the Email info link -> Observe mailto intent open

Navigate to / -> Scroll to Contact section -> Fill in name input field -> Fill in email input field with a valid email -> Fill in message textarea -> Submit the form -> Observe loading state on submit -> Observe success feedback indicating message was sent
Navigate to / -> Scroll to Contact section -> Attempt to submit the form with required fields empty -> Observe HTML5 validation prevents submission and indicates required fields

features.name: Footer
features.description: Footer with social links and copyright information to close out the page.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Scroll to footer -> Observe social icons for GitHub, LinkedIn and Email
Navigate to / -> Scroll to footer -> Select a social icon (GitHub or LinkedIn) -> Observe external profile open in a new tab
Navigate to / -> Scroll to footer -> Hover over a social icon -> Observe lift and cyan glow effect

features.name: Scroll Reveal Animations
features.description: Scroll-triggered reveal animations that animate sections into view as the user scrolls.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Scroll down the page slowly -> Observe sections fade/slide into view when scrolled into the viewport

features.name: Magnetic Button Effect
features.description: Interactive magnetic hover effect applied to buttons to increase tactile feedback.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Locate an interactive button on the page -> Hover over the button -> Observe magnetic pull effect and subtle transform
